source_notes: CU codes M01..M08 are transcribed from the official NOSS 'Training Hours Summary' for Level 5, which prints them against the competency-unit titles. The CoCU extract we first worked from has a blank CU Code column, and an earlier version of this graph used C01..C08 by analogy with the Level 3 sibling — that was a guess and it was wrong. Local copy: raw/noss-character/fb018-45-L5-training-hours-OFFICIAL.pdf (Jennifer's Drive, owner jennifer@character.com.mx).

The elective unit is coded M08, not E01: the Level 5 Training Hours Summary prints 'M08 TECHNOLOGY MANAGEMENT' beneath the heading 'COMPETENCY UNIT ELECTIVE'. It is elective by placement, not by an E-prefix. The CoCU gives its title as 'BUSINESS TECHNOLOGY MANAGEMENT' while the Training Hours Summary gives 'TECHNOLOGY MANAGEMENT'; the CoCU wording is kept as the fuller of the two.

The NOSS code year (2012) is not printed in the CoCU text; it is inferred from the sibling FB-018-3:2012 document and the fb018-45 filename. If a different year is found in the cover page of the original PDF, update noss_code accordingly.
CoCU p.10 C05 WA4 numbers criteria as 4.1, 4.3, 4.4 — there is no 4.2 in the printed standard. All three are transcribed as printed.
CoCU p.3 WA7 of C01 is formatted as '7.   Prepare marketing strategic plan' with the performance criterion on the same page continuation — transcribed verbatim as printed.
CoCU p.11 C06 WA8 criterion reads 'Report prepared and submitted to procedure according procedure' — likely a typographical error in the standard. Transcribed verbatim as printed.
